content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking advice. I have the following components: a [product_name] logical module and a probe room temperature sensor (0...10V). I would like to know which function should be used on the [product_name] module to work with the temperature sensor. When the temperature reaches 35 degrees, the engine supply should be cut off. How should it be wired? Thank you for your assistance.

Hi, You just need to connect U1 from the sensor to one of the analog inputs (for example, I7 or I8) on the [product_name] module. Using an analog function like analog threshold trigger is recommended. Set the input range as 0-10V, with 0 as the minimum and 50 (or 500 if you use one decimal place) as the maximum. Then program the ON and OFF threshold at 35 (or 350). Hope this helps!
Hi [user_name], Thanks for the guidance. That clarifies things for me. Have a great day.
